title: Sharp Bell-State Fidelity Ceiling, Exact Dimensional Threshold d_min = 8, and Universal Theta(1/sqrt(d)) Families of NPT Bound Entangled Werner States
abstract: Faisal (arXiv:2611.34921v1, 2026) recently settled the long-standing problem of the existence of negative-partial-transpose (NPT) bound entanglement by constructing a single Werner state rho(8, -3/23) = (23I - 3 SWAP)/1448 on C^8 x C^8 whose two-qubit outputs under arbitrary separable operations achieve Bell-state fidelity at most (1 + sqrt(2))/4 ~ 0.6036, via a 4096 x 4096 single-copy matrix certificate Q decomposed into 42 x 42 diagonal-unitary blocks. We resolve three fundamental questions left open by Faisal's breakthrough. First (Theorem 1), we prove that every two-qubit output of any separable operation on any number of copies of a coherence-bounded state is necessarily PPT and separable, sharpening Faisal's Bell-state fidelity ceiling from (1 + sqrt(2))/4 to the exact optimal separable ceiling 1/2 (saturated by |00><00|), and we lift every single certified endpoint rho(d, alpha_0) via an explicit local depolarizing channel to the entire continuous NPT interval alpha in [alpha_0, -1/d). Second (Theorem 2), by U(d) Haar twirling and a zero-square-root pure-integer Gram representation of the 24-dimensional walled Brauer algebra B_{3,1}(d) ~ C + C + M_2(C) + M_3(C) + M_3(C), we collapse Faisal's d^4 x d^4 feasibility problem to pure-integer matrices of size at most 3 x 3 (and 2 x 2 on J - Q) and prove — via 23 exact rational piecewise-McCormick SDP-dual certificates over Q — that Faisal's covariant local-map certificate mechanism is strictly impossible across the entire continuum of parameters for every dimension d in {3, 4, 5, 6, 7}, establishing d_min = 8 as the exact sharp dimensional threshold (continuous critical threshold d_crit ~ 7.2384). Third (Theorem 3), we provide the first zero-float rational verification of Faisal's d = 8 matrix Q, construct a 6-entry-sparse all-integer sharpened d = 8 certificate Q_8* expanding the certified NPT excess |8 alpha| - 1 by +34.18% to alpha_8* = -1000/7559, and exhibit a single explicit closed-form algebraic family Q(d) whose 24 nontrivial leading Sylvester minors have strictly positive shifted polynomial coefficients in t = sqrt(d) - 3 >= 0, certifying continuous intervals of NPT bound entangled Werner states of width Theta(1/sqrt(d)) (expanding past the PPT boundary 1/d by Theta(sqrt(d))) for every integer dimension d >= 9 simultaneously. All proofs are backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero sorry, zero Classical.choice), 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 rational certificates, and 56 adversarial unit tests including direct Hilbert-space cross-checks.
